diagnosis_en: Blocked carburetor + dirty spark plug. Engine coughs but won't catch.
diagnosis_pidgin: Carburetor block, spark plug dirty. Gen dey cough but e no gree catch.
steps_en: Turn off gen, close fuel valve, let it cool 10 mins.
Remove spark plug, clean with wire brush or replace.
Drain old fuel from carburetor bowl screw.
Clean air filter - wash foam, dry, light oil.
Open fuel valve, choke on, pull starter firmly.
steps_pidgin: Off gen, lock fuel valve, make e cool 10 mins.
Comot spark plug, brush am well or buy new one.
Drain old fuel from carburetor bottom screw.
Wash air filter foam, dry am, put small oil.
Open fuel valve, choke on, pull rope well-well.
danger_en: No smoking near fuel. Let engine cool - exhaust burns. Work outside.
danger_pidgin: No smoke near fuel o. Make gen cool - exhaust dey burn. Do am outside.

diagnosis_en: Black smoke = too much fuel, dirty air filter or choked carburetor.
diagnosis_pidgin: Black smoke mean say fuel too much, air filter dirty or carburetor wahala.
steps_en: Check choke is OFF after warm-up.
Remove and clean air filter thoroughly.
Drain carburetor bowl, check float needle.
Replace spark plug if black/sooty.
Run gen on half load 10 mins to clear.
steps_pidgin: Check choke - off am after gen warm.
Comot air filter, wash am well-well.
Drain carburetor, check float needle.
If plug black, change am.
Run gen with small load 10 mins make e clear.
danger_en: Hot exhaust. Don't breathe smoke. Outside only.
danger_pidgin: Exhaust hot. No breathe smoke. Outside only.

diagnosis_en: White smoke = too much oil or oil in combustion chamber.
diagnosis_pidgin: White smoke mean say oil too much or oil enter where fire dey burn.
steps_en: Turn off gen immediately, check oil level dipstick.
Drain excess oil to correct level (don't overfill).
Clean or replace air filter if oily.
Run 5 mins - if smoke continues, stop.
If smoke persists, rings/valves may be worn - take to shop.
steps_pidgin: Off gen now-now, check oil level.
Drain oil wey too much - no full am pass mark.
Clean air filter if oil don touch am.
Run 5 mins - if smoke still dey, stop am.
If e no stop, engine don chop ring - carry go rewinder.
danger_en: Hot oil burns. Don't run with low oil - engine will seize.
danger_pidgin: Hot oil dey burn. No run gen if oil low - engine go knock.

diagnosis_en: Engine runs but no power output - breaker tripped, AVR or brush fault.
diagnosis_pidgin: Gen dey run but e no bring light - breaker trip, AVR or brush wahala.
steps_en: Unplug all loads, reset AC breaker button.
Check AVR fuse/wires behind control panel.
Test with small load like phone charger + bulb.
If still no output, AVR likely dead.
AVR swap is 15 mins but needs care - consider shop.
steps_pidgin: Comot everything wey you plug, press breaker button.
Check AVR fuse/wire for back of panel.
Test with phone charger + bulb.
If light still no come, AVR don die.
To change AVR easy but e get as e be - fit carry go shop.
danger_en: Shock risk. Never open panel with gen running. Unplug loads first.
danger_pidgin: Light fit shock you. No open panel when gen dey run. Comot load first.

diagnosis_en: No sound at all when pulling - recoil starter or low oil cutoff.
diagnosis_pidgin: You pull rope, nothing happen - recoil starter or oil low.
steps_en: Check oil level - low-oil sensor blocks start.
Top up to mark with SAE 10W-30.
Check recoil rope - if loose/broken, open cover.
Check kill switch is ON/RUN position.
Try start with choke on, no load plugged.
steps_pidgin: Check oil - if oil low, gen no go start.
Top oil reach mark.
Check rope - if e loose or cut, open cover.
Check off/on switch dey for RUN.
Try start with choke, no plug anything.
danger_en: Keep fingers clear of flywheel when cover is open.
danger_pidgin: No put finger near flywheel when cover open.

diagnosis_en: Gen starts then cuts under load - overload or weak breaker.
diagnosis_pidgin: Gen start but e trip when you load am - load too much.
steps_en: Unplug everything, restart gen.
Add loads one by one - find the heavy one.
Don't exceed 80% of rated watts (2.5kVA ≈ 2000W max).
Fridge + AC + iron at once will trip small gen.
If trips with small load, breaker weak - replace.
steps_pidgin: Comot everything, start gen again.
Plug things one-one - find the one wey heavy pass.
No pass 80% of wetin gen fit carry.
Fridge + AC + iron together go trip small gen.
If e trip with small load, breaker don weak - change am.
danger_pidgin: No bypass breaker - fire fit catch.
